records.text: Rob McCoy organized the 2023 Covenant School memorial while Turning Point USA was holding a pastors summit nearby.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Rob McCoy was the person who organized the Nashville Covenant School memorial in 2023 because it just so happened that Turning Point was having a pastor's summit down the road when that happened, when the shooting happened.

verification.notes: The Covenant shooting occurred March 27, 2023 and a public memorial was held March 29. TPUSA's Nashville Pastors Summit occurred in late May 2023, not nearby at the time of the shooting. No reliable source shows McCoy organized the March memorial, so the statement's central timing and organizer claims are contradicted or unsupported.
